description: This is a platform-specific shell script for handling firmware upgrades in the OpenWrt Linux embedded operating system. It defines functions to check images and perform upgrades tailored to certain hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks or validates the firmware image; currently a placeholder that always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process depending on the detected board name; delegates to nand_do_upgrade or default_do_upgrade.
